coordinate_convention.fsaverage_orig: world RAS via vox2ras (== vox2ras_tkr for fsaverage); internal tkRAS frame
coordinate_convention.templateflow_h5: ITK/SimpleITK convention (LPS-internal); resampling interpreted by SimpleITK from NIfTI RAS headers

ras_lps.note: RAS and LPS must never be mixed by hand; SimpleITK reads NIfTI sform/qform so the h5 application is header-consistent; any manual composition must respect LPS convention

frozen_final_hop.usable_as: final hop ONLY; requires a compatible first hop whose source is fsaverage-orig/MNI305 (not present authoritatively)

no_fsaverage_as_nlin6_note: fsaverage/MNI305 must NEVER be treated as MNI152NLin6Asym; they are distinct spaces
composition_order: forward: moving(fsaverage orig) -> (project-derived warp) -> target grid; if 2-hop: apply hop1 then hop2 in head-to-target order; NN for discrete ribbon

interpolation_rule.future_binary_ribbon: NearestNeighbor (label-safe) for discrete/binary cortical ribbon geometry in target space
interpolation_rule.future_fractional: fractional ribbon/probability semantics to be defined separately later
interpolation_rule.note: NOT applied this round; frozen as future semantics only

do_not_conflate_note: Hippo/Amyg probability -> LINEAR interpolation does NOT carry over: cortical ribbon is discrete/binary geometry
